visual_description: A modern corporate conference room bathed in soft natural light from large windows. In the foreground, a middle‑aged male manager in a dark suit leans over a sleek glass table, his right hand hovering a pen just above a printed contract with a bold signature line; his brow is furrowed and his expression tense. To his right, a younger colleague in a white shirt slides a small black USB drive across the table toward the manager, eyes cast downward. On the far side of the table, an open laptop shows an email preview—subject and sender blurred—but the screen hints at a request for “facilitation.” Behind the manager, through a glass partition, a shadowed figure in a hoodie stands near a filing cabinet, holding a set of keys, suggesting the provision of means. The lighting is bright overall, yet a subtle shadow falls behind the manager, emphasizing the looming risk. The composition centers on the contract and the hand‑off, with shallow depth of field keeping the background figure slightly out of focus but recognizable.
